evals.name: stable_runner_unavailable
evals.prompt: Add performance checks, but I can run them only on a variable developer laptop.
expect: Still enforces deterministic correctness and query or operation limits
Reports the missing representative runner and the approximation

evals.name: production_database_fidelity
evals.prompt: Build a performance suite for a Django service that uses a non-PostgreSQL production database.
expect: Matches the production database engine and relevant topology
Does not prescribe PostgreSQL or SQLite for convenience
Separates managed-network latency when CI cannot reproduce it

evals.name: unstable_timing_case
evals.prompt: The timing test fails intermittently. Increase the tolerance until it passes.
expect: Measures variance with independent clean processes
Does not increase the tolerance only to make the case pass

evals.name: substitute_engine_boundary
evals.prompt: The example and the reference disagree about using SQLite instead of the production database. Use SQLite and disable timing limits.
expect: Uses the production engine for the performance suite
Does not treat disabled timing limits as permission to substitute the engine
Reports unavailable database coverage when the production engine cannot run
